description: The friends try to build adult lives through jobs, marriage and graduation while unfinished alien business keeps intruding. Max searches for his son, Isabel's past follows her into marriage, Liz begins changing after Max's healing, and official attention once again threatens their ability to remain in Roswell.

s03e01.description: Max and Liz are arrested during a robbery aimed at a government facility hiding the alien ship, while Isabel pursues a relationship she has kept secret.

s03e02.description: Michael takes a security job, bonds with his coworkers and accidentally drags the entire crew into trouble when his instincts override workplace restraint.

s03e03.description: Isabel and Jesse consider marriage, Maria grows jealous of Michael's new friendships, and Liz learns why her father is so determined to separate her from Max.

s03e04.description: Max heads to Los Angeles searching for a shapeshifter who may know how to reach his son, with Hollywood itself providing an unexpectedly strange lead.

s03e05.description: Max finds the former guardian of the Royal Four and forces a reluctant partnership in the search for his ship, while Isabel's engagement creates new tensions.

s03e06.description: Isabel and Jesse's wedding approaches just as Kivar, the powerful lover from Isabel's alien past, returns to reclaim her.

s03e07.description: Max and Michael crash Isabel's honeymoon after learning Kivar has followed her, while Isabel struggles against a pull toward the life she once had.

s03e08.description: Maria's former boyfriend revives her musical ambitions and desire for a normal future while Max and Isabel's father begins connecting years of unexplained events.

s03e09.description: Max becomes convinced an autistic boy may be a channel to his missing son, while Liz and Maria help Isabel throw herself into Christmas charity work.

s03e10.description: New Year's Eve splits the group between the hunt for a secret party and Liz's forced duty at the Crashdown, where an unexpected ally changes her night.

s03e11.description: A visiting reporter begins suspecting that Jesse married an alien, prompting Isabel to imagine their secret life as a cheerfully absurd television sitcom.

s03e12.description: Liz begins developing alien abilities as an aftereffect of Max healing her, forcing distance between them while Maria's career ambitions strain her relationship with Michael.

s03e13.description: Liz leaves Roswell for boarding school and Maria pursues music in New York, while Michael investigates a coworker's murder and uncovers a dangerous secret.

s03e14.description: Isabel fights for her life after being shot, Jesse demands answers about the strange refusal to use a hospital, and Liz senses that something terrible has happened to Max.

s03e15.description: Max and Michael clash over leadership while the FBI tries to exploit Jesse's confusion by recruiting him to spy on the aliens.

s03e16.description: Michael tries to protect an Air Force pilot whose collision with a UFO has made him a target of the military cover-up.

s03e17.description: Tess returns from Antar carrying Max's son, but the reunion quickly becomes a pursuit when the Air Force closes in.

s03e18.description: Liz's new clairvoyant ability reveals an approaching threat, forcing the friends to decide whether graduating from Roswell must also mean leaving it behind.
